# Get release months for all TODO songs
import json

# We have spotify_token and todo_songs list
release_months = {}

for song in todo_songs:
    title = song['title']
    artists = song['artists']
    query = f"{title} {artists}"
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, page_limit=5)
    # Find exact match: title matches and all artist names are in the result's artists
    found = None
    for item in results:
        if item['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            # Check artists: all artist names in the item's artists list
            item_artists = [a['name'].lower() for a in item['artists']]
            # Split artists by comma and strip
            expected_artists = [a.strip().lower() for a in artists.split(',')]
            if all(any(exp in ia for ia in item_artists) for exp in expected_artists):
                found = item
                break
    if found:
        release_date = found['release_date']
        # Format as MM/YYYY
        month = release_date[5:7]
        year = release_date[0:4]
        release_months[title] = f"{month}/{year}"
        print(f"{title} -> {release_months[title]}")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {title}")

print("Done fetching release months")
